create_a2a_streaming_iterator: create an A2AStreamingIterator to iterate over async streaming responses with token tracking
iterate_a2a_streaming_chunks: iterate over A2A streaming chunks using the async iterator protocol to collect and return each response chunk
collect_text_from_a2a_chunk: collect and extract text from an A2A streaming response chunk for token counting
